title: Variational GENERIC Structure and Preserving Integrators
exact_target: Find a variational formulation for full reversible and irreversible GENERIC dynamics and derive integrators that preserve its structure.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003664 (OWR-15959-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Variational Methods for Evolution (2017), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2017/54, pp. 3185--3261. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 34.
GENERIC integrators (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The whole coupled structure and the follow-on discretization question are required. A variational principle for the Hamiltonian part alone or for a dissipation-only gradient flow does not answer the original target.
